sections.title: Start & Restart of Play
items: Kick to a teammate from halfway.
Cannot score directly from kick‑off — ball must touch another player.
After a goal, the conceding team restarts from halfway.

sections.title: Scoring
items: Whole ball must cross the line.
Goals can only be scored from the opposition’s half.

sections.title: Offside
items: Players should not stand permanently in obvious offside positions.

sections.title: Ball Out of Play – Touch Line
items: Ball is kicked or dribbled back into play from behind the line.
Cannot score directly — ball must touch another player.

sections.title: Ball Out of Play – Goal Line
items: Defending team restarts from any point on their goal line.
Cannot score directly — ball must touch another player.

sections.title: Fouls & Misconduct
items: Most fouls are accidental — allow advantage where possible.
If deliberate, explain the rule simply and encourage better behaviour.

sections.title: Match Results & Ladders
items: No published scores, tables, or ladders.
Clubs, Associations, and Federations must not publish results.
